decision.decision: Retain bounded single-start liveness for broad sparse-read queries: both matched compiler blocks improve, retired instructions fall, all generated bytes remain identical. Preserve adverse compiler memory and unrelated-stage timing movement.

hardware: Apple M3 Air, 8 cores (4P+4E), 16 GB, macOS 26.2
scope: Fresh current 61-flag control; eight serial ABBA/BAAB complete source-to-Object observations. Historical 60-flag cohorts and separate screens/baseline observations are not pooled. Both compiler-time blocks improve; every program and fixture byte matches.

Builds, tests, profiling, capture, kernel/oracle work, copying, hashing and archive work do not overlap primary compiles. Candidate bootstrap overlaps the separate offline oracle; bootstrap numbers use existing caches and are not isolated matched or cold-bootstrap comparisons.

The caller still constructs and validates each entire exact graph, predicate context and definition inventory in the original order. Only the pure solution is changed. Broad sparse-read graphs try a bounded reverse search at the requested start; original packed/sparse fallback remains.

All 790 original query inputs and expected results are captured and independently re-solved with a different full-bitset worklist. All 12640 kernel observations assert exact results; prototype search matches production body. Eligibility scans are outside kernel timers but included in complete compiler timings.

Temporary diagnostic/capture code is not retained. Summary and detail profiles preserve graph/result cardinalities and every output byte. Detail clocks add substantial overhead and do not qualify a performance change. Failed no-LTO capture link is preserved; qualification uses ordinary optimized compiler-profile Thin LTO.

Maximum compiler RSS and footprint increase; all adverse phases and every observation remain. No isolated cause is assigned to memory/unrelated-stage movement. No new compressor-runtime latency campaign is claimed: Object and complete metadata are identical. No scalar execution machinery is retired.

Grammar, language, checked errors, direct scalar emission, fresh shape/factory/visit/ownership checks, finite admission, accounting and backend settings remain. Full compilation remains above ten seconds. Pure replay checks stored data and independent graph results; it does not rerun timings.
